messages:
ella: Kicking off coordinated window for runtime+api+console+router. Target window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Sequence suggestion: router -> runtime -> api -> console. Pin set proposals: runtime=v3.7.2, api=v1.14.0, console=v2.2.0, router=v5.0.0-alpha. Please call out hard blockers now.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 20% for 20m -> 50% for 30m -> 100%. Auto-rollback hooks configured but disabled until handoff.

tom: Quick note: runtime change includes KV cache eviction tweak. If p99 token latency increases >20% above baseline during canary, we should rollback runtime-only.

li: Console change relies on a router header-split flag. If router doesn't expose header X-Runtime-Variant, console routes will 500. We need a compatibility flag or console feature-guard.

sophia: Are we sure about router first? Router change is larger surface. Router-first means runtime can be behind. Maybe do runtime -> router -> api -> console? Router-first avoids old router routing to new runtime kernels though.

ella: Opinion: router must be able to route to both old and new runtime kernels. If we can gate the header split behind a feature flag, we can push router, enable feature off, then push runtime and flip routing. That minimizes risk for console.

li: OK that works. We'll keep router feature-flag off during runtime deploy. Console team will hold on enabling until we flip the flag.

deploy-bot: Reminder: pin versions in deploy metadata. Use pinned_variant label: {router:v5.0.0-alpha, runtime:v3.7.2}. Deploybot will enforce pinned variants during canary.

ella: Rollback criteria (proposal):
- p99 latency across API/runtime > 20% baseline for 2 consecutive 5m buckets -> rollback runtime.
- error rate (5xx) increase > 1.5x baseline for 2 consecutive buckets -> rollback affected service.
- console 500s after header flip -> immediate console rollback and router flag off.

opsbot: Runbook created -> https://intra.redwood/release-runbooks/2026-04-02-crossservice-canary (opsdoc). Add postmortem checklist link.

tom: Adding small run: health checks to include: KV eviction rate, cache hit ratio, api token gen latency, router header miss metric. If cache hit ratio drops >10% we may see cost spike.

li: For deployment order let's do: 1) Push router (feature off) + pin, 2) Push runtime, canary runtime, 3) Push API (thin changes) 4) Flip router feature to route to new kernels gradually 5) Push console + enable console feature.

ella: Agree. Also note console has a strict schema change for /routes endpoint - include deserialization backward compat. Sophia, please confirm console readiness in 30m.

sophia: Confirmed - console schema has compatibility guard. Will hold 10m after router flip before enabling.

li: Deploy commands for quick reference:
```bash
# start router canary (feature off)
deploy start router --version v5.0.0-alpha --canary 5 --labels pinned_variant=router:v5.0.0-alpha
# rollback runtime
deploy rollback runtime --to v3.7.1 --timeout 15m
```

ella: Communication plan: post #release-notes when router pinned, then again at each major stage. Pager contacts: tom (runtime), li (router), sophia (console), ella (release lead). If any of the three alerts hit, abort staged increase and meet in #release-war-room.

deploy-bot: Canary health monitor set: p99_latency, 5xx_rate, kv_eviction_rate, console_header_miss. Alerts: slack @channel + page on sev > 1.

tom: One more: quantify traffic cushion. We'll keep 15% traffic cushion for router until final 100% to allow rollback without saturation.

ella: Good. Release notes draft: bullet list of runtime kernel selection improvements, KV eviction tuning, API minor endpoint optimization, router header split behind flag, console compatibility guard. I'll paste before ship for review.

sophia: Readying console changelog now. Will add migration note for customers using direct route webhook.

li: All set from router side. Feature gated and metrics hooked. Will post when canary starts.

ella: Final check-in 10m before 22:00. If no blockers, we proceed with order above. :thumbsup:
